body.name: Thresholded coordinate decoder \(\widehat{\mathsf R}_{\alpha,g}\)
body.construction: Invert \(\widehat\Sigma_c\); detect an entry of \(\widehat K_c-\widehat K_d\) when its magnitude exceeds \(\alpha/2\); recognize a coordinate pair by one detected diagonal and no other detected entry; orient it toward the endpoint whose corresponding marginal is closer to any third component; then apply singleton row-support matching.
